A steady breather is a gradient steady soliton.
Proof

↗ prop:kl-invariant-its-applications-monotonicity-entropy \sketch Diffeomorphism invariance gives $\lambda (t_2)=\lambda (t_1)$, hence equality in the preceding monotonicity proof. Equation (14) yields $R_{ij}+ abla _i abla _jf=0$, and (13) is therefore the steady soliton equation.

□
